title: Bitwarden
settings.email.label: Account email
settings.email.description: Email address of your Bitwarden account. It is written to rbw's configuration and never shown in the vault.
settings.base_url.label: Server URL
settings.base_url.description: Bitwarden server URL, for example https://vault.bitwarden.com. Leave empty to keep rbw's current server.
settings.sync_on_unlock.label: Sync after unlock
settings.sync_on_unlock.description: Fetch the latest vault from the server right after a successful unlock.
settings.clear_clipboard_seconds.label: Clear clipboard after
settings.clear_clipboard_seconds.descrip: Seconds before a copied secret is replaced in the clipboard. 0 keeps it until the next copy.
settings.lock_on_close.label: Lock when the panel closes
settings.lock_on_close.description: Lock the vault and drop the decrypted items whenever the panel closes.
state.no_rbw_body: This plugin reads the vault through rbw. Install it and reopen the panel.
state.setup_body: Add your Bitwarden account email in the plugin settings. Optionally set a self-hosted server URL.
state.locked_body: Unlock the vault to read your items. rbw asks for the master password in its pinentry window.
state.unlocking_body: Enter the master password in the pinentry window. The vault opens as soon as rbw reports success.
detail.empty_body: Pick an item from the list on the left to see its details.
